main_text.p: הִתְפַּקְּדוּ recensiti sunt, Jud.20.15. הִתְפַּקְּדוּ recensiti sunt, Num. 1. 47. ex Hoph.& Hitph. pro הִתְפַּקְּדִי, præt. Hithp. 3. pl. R. פָּקַר.
הִתְקַלְקְלוּ levantur, præt. Hithp. 3. pl. Rad. קָלַל.
הִתְקַשְּׁשׁוּ excutite vos, Imper. Hithp. pl. m. Rad. קשש.
הָתָר dissolvere, Infin. vel Imper. Hiph. sing. masc. Rad. נָתַר.
pro וְהִרְעָה, Infin. Hithp. Rad. רָעָה.
הִתְרוֹעֵעַ clangentem egit, præt. Hithp. 3. f. m. vel Imper. sing. m. unde הִתְרוֹעֲעַ clangentem age, Imper. f. fæm. R. רוּעַ, vel רָעֲעָ.
הִתְרַפִּיתְ remisse tegeras, præt. Hithp. 2. sing. masc. Rad. רָפָה.
הִתְשׁוֹטְטָה cursitate, Jer. 49.3. Imper. Hithp. pl. fæm. (pro הִתְשׁוֹטְטָנָה) à Rad. שׁוּט.
וָמֵךְ & percussi, fut. Hiph. 1. sing. Vau conv. præf. apoc. pro וָאֶבָּה, R. נָבָה.
וָאֶבַל & consumam, fut. Pihel 1. f. Vau cop. præf. apoc. pro וָאֲבֵלָה, Rad. אבל.
וָאֶעֱלֶ & ascendi, 1. sing. fut. Kal., Vau conv. apoc. pro וָאֶעֱלָה, R. עָלָה.
וָאֶעֵל & obtuli, fut. Hiph. 1. sing. Vau conv. apoc. pro וָאֶעֱלָה, R. עָלָה.
וָאֶעֲנֶ & respondi, fut. Kal 1. sing. Vau conv. apoc. pro וָאֶעֲנֶה, R. עָנָה.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and consonants in the small, damaged type are doubtful throughout; the Hebrew forms above are approximate and should be checked against the scan. Running heads and the centred letter marker are read as Hebrew letters and may be wrong. The page number 103 is read from a worn print. Speckling and stains on the page were ignored.
